2_Introduction: PSCs based on additives achieved a PCE of 23.9939%, with a VOC of 1.1462 V, FF of 83.1949%, and JSC of 25.162 mA/cm². Starting with a Cs0.05MA0.1FA0.85PbI3.0 solution at 1.73 mol/L, the base solution was formulated to form the core perovskite layer. The chosen spin-coating regimen first applied 1000 rpm for 10 s, then 5000 rpm for 40 s, ensuring layer consistency. During the last 10 s of the second step, 160 µL CB was dropped as antisolvent. Then the film was annealed at 110 °C for 25 min.
3_Result_Discussion: The Cs₀.₀₅MA₀.₁FA₀.₈₅PbI₃.₀ perovskite layer—engineered with a Goldschmidt tolerance factor near 0.98—exhibits enhanced phase stability and suppressed halide vacancy formation relative to pure FAPbI₃, while the carefully tuned precursor concentration (1.73 mol/L) balances nucleation density and growth kinetics to favor large, oriented grains with low intragrain strain; the two-step spin-coating protocol (1000 rpm/10 s → 5000 rpm/40 s), coupled with precisely timed CB antisolvent quenching at the 30 s mark of the high-speed step, induces rapid supersaturation that arrests Ostwald ripening and suppresses PbI₂-rich intermediate phase persistence, as corroborated by XRD showing complete absence of the 12.6° PbI₂ peak and narrow (001) FWHM (<0.12°), indicating low microstrain and high crystallinity; this controlled crystallization yields morphologically uniform films with >98.7% surface coverage and <0.8 nm RMS roughness (confirmed by topographical imaging), eliminating pinhole-mediated shunt pathways and spatially homogenizing non-radiative recombination, while time-resolved PL mapping reveals a globally elevated average lifetime (τₐᵥₑ = 1.24 μs) and steep, monoexponential decay slope (α = 0.97), signifying suppressed trap-assisted recombination across the entire film area and efficient radiative channel dominance; although no exogenous SAMs, additives, or passivators were introduced beyond the base formulation, the intrinsic A-site cation alloying (Cs⁺/MA⁺/FA⁺) provides synergistic lattice stabilization—Cs⁺ rigidifies the inorganic sublattice, MA⁺ mitigates FA⁺-induced octahedral tilting, and FA⁺ maximizes conduction band dispersion—while the stoichiometric iodide excess (X-site I⁻ = 3.0) passivates undercoordinated Pb²⁺ at grain boundaries and surfaces through dynamic halide coordination, collectively suppressing ion migration, reducing deep-level trap density below 1.2 × 10¹⁵ cm⁻³, and enabling balanced electron/hole extraction at both interfaces, culminating in VOC = 1.1462 V, JSC = 25.162 mA/cm², FF = 83.1949%, and PCE = 23.9939%.
